shortBio.en: Pink Floyd bassist and primary lyric writer through The Wall era.
shortBio.zh: Pink Floyd 贝斯手；至《The Wall》时期主要作词人。

body.en:
Born 1943. Bassist from the start. After Barrett leaves, takes more lyric and concept lead through Dark Side, Wish You Were Here, Animals, and The Wall.

Leaves in the mid-1980s; later solo and The Wall tour projects.
body.zh:
1943 年生。从一开始任贝斯。Barrett 离队后，在《Dark Side》《Wish You Were Here》《Animals》《The Wall》中承担更多歌词与概念主线。

1980 年代中期离队；后有个人与 The Wall 巡演项目。
